_comment: mt5-robot-tester pipeline config. Copy this file, fill in the paths, do not commit personal paths, and pass it with --config. All three folders must be under MQL5\Experts so the tester can run them.
_terminal_path_help: Precedence, highest to lowest: --terminal-path, this terminal_path value, then $MT5_TERMINAL_PATH. Set this to a portable, tester-only terminal64.exe path; the highest-precedence supplied path is used and errors out rather than falling through if missing. Auto-discovery under Program Files is OFF by default for safety; only --allow-auto-detect restores it, and never when a path is already supplied.
_sets_dir_help: Optional folder containing <bot_name>.set EA inputs. Round 3 parameter optimization requires it; without one, R3 is skipped and the Round 2 result determines the verdict.

common._symbols_help: REQUIRED: Market Watch symbols to test in Round 1, one backtest per symbol. Replace this example FTMO Market Watch list with your symbols:

gates._mode_help: mode=ftmo: the finalist decision is the Trading Prophet FTMO verdict (scripts/prophet.py), not profit multiples.

ftmo.bars_dir: <folder with 1-minute bar CSVs per symbol, e.g. EURUSD_M1.csv>
